description: Canonical cross-language Quiz Markdown conformance fixtures (P2-M1-D, Quizopia_System issue #9). Byte-identical copies live in hhtuann/Quizopia_Backend (src/test/resources/markdown/) and hhtuann/quizopia_frontend (lib/quiz-markdown/conformance/); SHA-256 must match.
comparison: Valid cases: full normalized question structure (number, type, stem/options/numericAnswer/explanation; content joined with \n).

Invalid cases: diagnostics compared as an unordered set of code|questionNumber|line|column tuples (duplicate identical tuples collapse; intentional ordering differences between Java and TypeScript are ignored).
Java returns no content for invalid sources; TypeScript may expose partially parsed questions for live preview. Only validity and diagnostics are authoritative in this file.
